newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Norway's NetCom started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Norway's NetCom started.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said on Monday it had started coverage of Norwegian cellular telephone operator NetCom GSM with a rating of market performer.
-- "We believe that, despite the high current levels of penetration, growth prospects in the Norwegian market remain good," the firm said in an analysis.
-- "We consider that NetCom is fairly valued at current levels, according to our discounted cash flow analysis," it said, adding that the 12-month price target was 63 crowns.
-- The company's shares closed at 57 on Monday.
